summary: Makes onSave async so it writes a JSON snapshot of the in-memory note store to data/notes.json after each save.

findings.title: Async onSave breaks the synchronous dispatch caller
findings.problem: The change makes onSave async, so dispatch in src/router.js:7 now returns a Promise for save actions. The server in src/main.js:9 passes that Promise straight to res.end, which accepts only a string or Buffer.
findings.consequence: Every POST /save request makes res.end throw a TypeError inside the request listener, which crashes the server. The writeFile promise also floats, so a failed write becomes an unhandled rejection.
findings.fix: Make dispatch and the request handler await the result before calling res.end. Catch errors there and answer with a 500 status.

findings.title: Snapshot write has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a file write and an async return to onSave. No test in the repository exercises onSave or the snapshot file.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the crash in the save path. Future regressions in the snapshot write will also go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a test that calls dispatch with the save action. The test should check the response text and the contents of the snapshot file.
